description: This file defines UI components for the Mattermost system console, specifically a UsersTable component and a UserRow component for managing and interacting with user data in end-to-end tests using Playwright.

classes.name: UsersTable
classes.description: Represents the users table component in the system console UI, providing methods to interact with user list, sort columns, and wait for loading to complete.

classes.name: UserRow
classes.description: Represents a single row in the users table, providing methods to access user details, open action menus, and interact with individual user entries.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the users table or user row is visible in the UI.

methods.name: getRowByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a UserRow object at the specified index.

methods.name: getColumnHeader
methods.description: Returns the Locator for a specified column header by display name.

methods.name: clickSortOnColumn
methods.description: Clicks on a column header to trigger sorting.

methods.name: sortByColumn
methods.description: Sorts the table by the specified column and returns the new sort direction.

methods.name: waitForLoadingComplete
methods.description: Waits for loading spinners to disappear and for the table to stabilize.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Simulates clicking on a user row.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the email address from the user row.

methods.name: openActionMenu
methods.description: Opens the action menu for a user and returns the UserActionMenu object.
